quarantine_policy: Save exact bytes and path/mode/sha plus aggregate/scoped delta before restoring or moving anything. Shelved new test/runner files live in hash-bound source quarantine with a restoration map. Never delete the only copy.
materialization: Shared-worktree result.json, source/routes/diff/build/artifact/test/worker manifests and exact hashes. No commit/push required.

notification.failure: Preserve exact notification/tool error; never claim delivery without response.
